item.title: Huntington man pleads guilty to federal drug crimes
item.description: CHARLESTON, WV (WVNS) -- A Huntington man pleaded guilty to federal drug charges on February 17, 2026. Daniel Legette, 50, of Huntington, pleaded guilty to distribution of fentanyl and cocaine base. According to court documents and statements, Legette sold roughly .65 grams of fentanyl and .42 grams of crack to a confidential informant in Huntington. [...]
